{{Quote|I am Lonay, son of Mogra'daal, nothing but a clanless wanderer in the sea of stars.|Decorative Twi'leki pictograph adorning Lonay's lekku|<ref name="The Regalia of Office">{{WEGCite|story=The Regalia of Office|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
'''Lonay''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] reign, and a cousin of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Tru'eb Cholakk]]. He was described as sly, clever, and cowardly. He wore his [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] draped over his left shoulder, and was usually seen wearing garish jewelry. His cowardice prevented him from ever taking leadership of Black Sun.

==Biography==
{{Quote|No jumped up Corellian dirt farmer swoop jockey beats me at sabacc!|Lonay|<ref name="DS">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>}}
Lonay was the son of [[Mogra'daal]] and distant relative of [[Tru'eb Cholakk]]. By the time he became a Vigo, he was [[clan]]less.<ref name="regal">{{WEGCite|story=The Regalia of Office|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref> His early life was a matter of rumor and speculation. A gossip circulating among his underlings went that he was the son of a [[Clan Chief]], obsessed with flashy works of art, and he sold Lonay to [[slavery/Legends|slavery]] to pay for his collection.<ref name="sotesb" />

[[File:Sore_Loser.png|thumb|left|Lonay, after losing a sabacc game to Kimmi Chyler.]]
[[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] placed Lonay in charge of silencing [[Kodo Finn]], and he hired the [[Nashtah Gang]] to do so. Xizor took his anger out on Lonay when the gang failed. 
Later, he helped save [[Mako Spince]]'s life from the [[NaQoit Bandits|NaQuoit Bandits]] and installed him as a traffic controller on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and as [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and [[Ear/Legends|ears]] for [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] on the Smuggler's Moon. Spince thanked him with a [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] brooch.<ref name="regal" />

Lonay seemed to prefer to pursue enterprises away from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Unusually for a Vigo (and for a Twi'lek), he limited himself in the criminal operations of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], where he had allies not only associated with the Black Sun, but also other corporate/criminal interests.<ref name="sotesb" /> When the [[Mytaranor Slaving Council]] was still young, Lonay saved its members from [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Alexander Julstan IV|Julstan]]'s [[Imperial Navy|fleet]]. To thank him, they presented him with a precious [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca]] pin.<ref name="regal" /> With some careful movements, he gained control of the Council, and allowed it to acquire several vessels, including a [[Mandalorian dungeon ship]], which greatly benefited the [[slavery/Legends|slavers]], an investment worth the costs.<ref name="sotesb">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

On the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] Lonay, willing to play [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], visited the largest [[Casino/Legends|casino]] in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Nashal]]. He was playing against [[Kimmi Chyler]], a famous swoop racer, who, when Lonay had wagered all his credits on a final showdown, beat him with a pure sabacc. The vigo went furious over his defeat and his guards had to hustle him out of the casino. However, they soon confronted Chyler and her bodyguard, once they left the casino, Lonay accused Chyler of cheating and stated that she had a [[Skifter/Legends|skifter]]. Chyler and her companion immediately jumped on a nearby swoop, but Lonay and his thugs followed them in a [[XP-38 sport landspeeder]]. After a high-speed chase through the streets of Talus Chyler swung her swoop into a dead-end alley, with Lonay's speeder following just behind. At full speed she stood on the braking vanes and the swoop headed straight up out of the alley, while the speeder hit the wall hard. Chyler hovered for a second to appreciate the wreckage, but Lonay managed only to shake his fist at her, before she took the swoop into the night.<ref>{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

[[File:Lonay_-_SWGTCG.jpg|thumb|Lonay]]
The next day Lonay was approached by an agent of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. His guards initially declined him the talk with the Vigo, but Lonay ordered them to let them in after the agent said that he was sent by [[Namman Cha]]. Embarrassed, with bumps and bruises on his face, head, and arms from the speeder crash, he told the Imperial about his setback and asked him to avenge his honor. The operative needed Lonay's cooperation for his investigation, so he accepted the job. He soon returned to the Vigo, telling him that while confronted in an alley, Chyler turned tail and ran, barely escaping with her life. Lonay was pleased with the result and explained that the Imperial would find help of [[Wrenga Jixton]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="DS" />

During the height of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Lonay's businesses started to suffer. Not only several of his underlings joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], but the Rebels also striked against his slave vessels, or influenced some [[Star system/Legends|systems]] to pass anti-slavery laws. Myrtaranor remained lucrative, thanks to his past investments to it, but his lesser slaving syndicates had losses. He partly tried to compensate by increasing his [[spice/Legends|spice]] trade, thanks to his native [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] sources, and profitted by the arms trade during the War.<ref name="sotesb" />

To hide his dire situation, Lonay kept on wearing garish robes and ornamenting himself with [[jewel]]s and decorations. [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] had noticed his lower revenues and temporarily tolerated him.<ref name="sotesb" />

After the [[occupation of Bespin]], Xizor summoned the Vigos to [[Xizor's Palace|his palace]] for a meeting. As usual, he complied immediately, and came with his entourage to the Imperial Center avoiding detection. In the apartment Xizor always provided him, he had a chest with his personal treasures. When [[Howzmin]] summoned him, once more he wore his rich robes and sashes and decorated himself.<ref name="regal" /> They all gathered in the antechamber, and were relieved of their weapons by Howzmin. Everyone knew that Xizor discovered something and wanted to make an example of the culpit to the remaining eight of them. As for Lonay, he did not worry about himself; he knew that Xizor was tolerating his temporary lower slave trade, and that he didn't do something like some sort of betrayal, that would cause Xizor's wrath; he waited patiently until they were summoned by [[Guri]].<ref>{{WEGCite|story=The Obvious Scapegoat|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref> At the conclusion of the meeting, Lonay witnessed as Xizor had Guri [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Green]] in front of the other Vigos, as a message to any Vigos who would try to sell information.<ref name="guri">{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=Beautiful... and Lethal|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC009.jpg}}</ref><ref name="novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>

That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] Rebel Alliance leader, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], sought the aid of [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] in her efforts to rescue her fellow Rebel, Human smuggler [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who had fallen into the clutches of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. Organa also sought information on who was trying to assassinate her friend, the Human [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="SOTEc 4">[[Shadows of the Empire 4|''Shadows of the Empire'' 4]]</ref> Because Organa and her Wookiee companion, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], were well-known members of the Rebel Alliance, they required a means of sneaking past the Imperial customs agents waiting for them in [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]], the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], where Black Sun's headquarters was located. Guri agreed to help them do so, and they decided that Chewbacca should be disguised as [[Snoova]], a famous Wookiee bounty hunter.<ref name="novel" />

[[File:SnoovaChained-SotESourcebook.png|thumb|Lonay approaches a chained Snoova.]]
Lonay arranged the capture of Snoova, who was assaulted by Lonay's thugs outside [[Asteria's townhouse]], and taken into a tiny cell within a slave camp; his arms chained above his head and his hands encased in mitts to prevent him from lashing out with his claws. When they saw that he regained his senses, Lonay opened the cell's door and informed the prisoner that he had been taken "out of the picture" for a time so that someone could impersonate the hunter on Coruscant. Despite Snoova's angry threats and attempts to break free (Lonay's jewellery jangled as Snoova growled), the Twi'lek told the Wookiee that he would receive substantial recompense for the arrangement.<ref>{{WEGCite|story=Out of the Picture|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>

After Xizor's death in the [[Battle over Coruscant]], and the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Black Sun was in chaos that resulted to [[Black Sun civil war|an internal war]]. The Vigos had council meeting about the future. Lonay started taking initiatives, and he was cut by [[Wumdi]] and [[Clezo]]. A human female, filling Green's position, was present.<ref name="see3">[[Shadows of the Empire: Evolution 3|''Shadows of the Empire: Evolution'' 3]]</ref>

During a later meeting, the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]] showed up after the human female's invitation. Then the room was invaded by thugs, who were quickly slaughtered. The human female identified the bodies as [[Vekker (Quarren)|Vekker's]] soldiers; nobody knew that the mysterious human who was actually [[Savan]] in disguise, and the one responsible for the attack to incriminate Vekker.<ref name="see3" />

==Personality and traits==
{{quote|One's master is another's slave. Such is the way of the universe.|Lonay|<ref name="regal" />}}
Lonay was a clanless twi'lek. Apparently, in order to avoid disturbing the Empire, Lonay limited himself in the smaller businesses of the Outer Room, something that put him aside of Twi'lek criminal practices and the strategies of other more ambitious Vigos. Lonay recognised his place and Xizor's authority, and behaved like a slave in front of the Dark Prince. He saved his ruthlessness and deviousness for his underlings and customers.<ref name="sotesb" /> He always responded to Xizor's summons, arriving to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from the Outer Rim in record time, and avoiding detection, per Xizor's long-standign orders.<ref name="regal" />

During his many exploits, Lonay liked collecting precious souvenirs, some of them gifts presented to him by entities he benefitted. He loved wearing them over his lavish robes, and other decorations, such as [[Tattoo/Legends|tatooing]] his [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]]. He also wore a jeweled dagger, displaying his authority. Some said this tendency was rooted in his rumored background. When Lonay entered a darker financial period, he made a conscious effort to keep looking opulent, and looking equal to the other Vigos.<ref name="regal" /><ref name="sotesb" />
